description.value:
The Linear-Scattering Thermic Ammunition Rifle is the first fully automatic electrothermal firearm ever designed. Arasaka claim they didn’t steal the design from Militech, who definitely didn’t just slap an automatic receiver onto an old model, which was definitely built to withstand rapid firing of plasma inside its chamber. Despite none of this being true, one thing is: The L-STAR turns targets into fine red mists of superheated meat.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Exotic Machine Gun • Skill: N/A • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 60 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Bipod • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Expansive Ammunition, and can only fire in Autofire and Suppressive Fire. If this weapon is fired twice within 6 seconds (2 Rounds), its quality reduces to Poor Quality until it is vented by the user as an Action. When rolling for Autofire damage with this weapon, it only requires a single d6 damage die to result in a 6 for it to incur a Critical Injury. This weapon cannot be modified or fabricated by a Tech unless they possess Maker Rank 8 or higher. Requires BODY 6+ to wield unless Mounted.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Bipod (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
